These include multiple airbags throughout the cabin, such as front-impact, side-impact, and overhead airbags for head protection. Stability control and traction control systems work together to maintain vehicle stability in various driving conditions. description: This 2022 Lamborghini Huracan EVO RWD Coupe in Rosso Anteros Metallic is for sale at Sienna Collection in Pompano Beach, Florida. It is the rear-wheel-drive version of the EVO, the one enthusiasts seek out because every bit of the V10's output goes to the back axle. A low-mileage, pre-owned example in metallic red over a black Nero Ade leather cabin, it pairs a classic Lamborghini color combination with the more driver-focused of the two EVO layouts. Behind the seats sits a 5.2-liter naturally aspirated V10 rated at 602 horsepower and 413 lb-ft of torque, matched to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Drive reaches the rear wheels through a mechanical limited-slip differential, and the chassis rides on sport-tuned double-wishbone suspension overseen by Lamborghini's LDVI electronic stability control. A dual stainless-steel performance exhaust gives the V10 its voice. The car wears 19-inch Kari Silver alloy wheels on Pirelli P Zero tires, with LED headlights and LED daytime running lights up front. Inside, the Nero Ade leather interior includes sport seats, the Lamborghini Branding Package with embossed shields on the headrests, a Lamborghini signature on the dashboard, a full Alcantara headliner, a leather-upholstered dashboard, Piano Black trim and aluminum accents. Daily usability is better than the shape suggests. The 2022 Lamborghini Huracan EVO carries a configurable 12.3-inch TFT digital instrument cluster and a vertically mounted 8.4-inch touchscreen with integrated navigation, real-time traffic, Bluetooth and streaming audio. Dual-zone automatic climate control, front and rear parking sensors, a rearview camera, cruise control and power-folding heated mirrors round out the equipment, and a drive mode selector lets the driver change the car's character. This is a Huracan for the buyer who values throttle response, steering feel and a naturally aspirated engine over all-wheel-drive traction, and who wants a modern Lamborghini that still asks something of its driver. See this 2022 Lamborghini Huracan EVO at Sienna Collection, 2741 North Federal Highway, Pompano Beach, FL 33064. We serve Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton, Miami and all of South Florida, with financing and trade-ins available. Call (954) 784-7181 and ask for Stock #A20864C.

Carbon-Ceramic Braking System: High-performance carbon-ceramic brakes with striking red calipers deliver exceptional stopping capability and unmistakable supercar styling.

Monolock Forged Wheels: Lightweight forged wheels enhance the Aventador's aggressive stance and performance-focused design.

Lamborghini Sensonum Premium Audio: Factory premium sound system designed to deliver an immersive listening experience within the Aventador's exclusive cockpit.

Magneto-Rheological Suspension: Electronically controlled front and rear dampers with push-rod suspension architecture provide exceptional handling precision and dynamic response.

With over $180,000 invested in the build alone, it pairs serious hardware with the tuning, drivetrain, fuel system, and electronics needed to put it to work.At the heart of the car is a Boostin Performance 4.1L engine featuring forged pistons and connecting rods, a Sonny Bryant billet crankshaft, and CNC-ported cylinder heads. An ETS Pro Series turbo system with twin Precision 6875 turbos supplies the boost, supported by an AMS/ALPHA Race X intercooler, carbon fiber intake manifold, and a complete dual-rail fuel system. The combination is capable of producing over 2,000 horsepower at the wheels on full power.Just as much attention went into controlling that power. Boostin Performance tuned the car on a MoTeC M150 ECU with flex-fuel capability, switchable maps, traction control, and full datalogging. Power selection ranges from approximately 1,000WHP to over 2,000WHP, allowing the driver to tailor the car to the fuel and conditions. Pressure monitoring for the coolant, oil, and fuel systems adds another layer of protection through programmed safety trips.That flexibility is a major part of what makes this GT-R special. With the appropriate map selected, Boostin Performance’s calibration and MoTeC traction control allow it to retain civil street manners. Turn it up at the track, and the capability is substantial: its best quarter-mile pass to date is 7.2 seconds at 193 MPH, with additional performance still on the table.The supporting equipment is equally extensive. A ShepTrans Stage 5 transmission, upgraded ETS unit, Wavetrac differentials, and Driveshaft Shop components address the drivetrain. Lightweight AK Motorsports tubular subframes, SPL suspension links, GT1R carbon ceramic brakes, and a dedicated drag rear sway bar round out the chassis.Outside, Seibon dry carbon fiber panels retain the factory body lines while reducing weight. description: 2012 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport 4LT Coupe For Sale in "Arctic White!" 6-Speed Manual 4LT Premium Package F55 Magnetic Ride Grand Sport Heritage Package 35K Miles Clean Carfax WE FINANCE There are certain Corvette configurations that enthusiasts have really started paying attention to, and a six-speed manual C6 Grand Sport is high on that list. This particular 2012 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport 4LT Coupe is a great example of why. Finished in Arctic White with Victory Red Grand Sport fender stripes, chrome Grand Sport wheels, red brake calipers, and a Black leather and suede interior with contrasting red stitching , this is an exceptionally attractive combination. Add in just 35K miles, a Clean Carfax, and a six-speed manual transmission , and you've already got the foundation for a pretty desirable Corvette. But the options list is where this one gets particularly interesting. The Right Transmission. The Right Options. The C6 Grand Sport has always occupied an interesting place in Corvette history. It combines the legendary 6.2L LS3 V8 with the wider bodywork, larger brakes, and more aggressive chassis of the Z06-inspired Grand Sport platform, while retaining the everyday usability that made the C6 such a successful sports car. And in a six-speed manual Grand Sport Coupe , you get something particularly appealing: a naturally aspirated V8, a proper three-pedal driving experience, and the additional performance hardware that came with the manual Grand Sport configuration. As enthusiasts increasingly seek out manual-transmission Corvettes, these cars have developed a following of their own. While market values will always fluctuate, there's no question that the combination of a manual gearbox, desirable factory equipment, and lower mileage is an important part of what separates one Grand Sport from another. This one has considerably more going for it than just the transmission. It's equipped with the 4LT Premium Equipment Package , the highest interior equipment level offered on the Grand Sport, bringing upgraded leather and suede appointments along with the comfort and convenience features you'd expect from a well-optioned Corvette. Even more interesting is the F55 Magnetic Selective Ride Control , an optional suspension system that allows the driver to select between Tour and Sport settings. It's an especially desirable feature on a Grand Sport, offering a level of adjustability that makes the car equally appealing for spirited driving or a weekend road trip. Combine that with the Grand Sport Heritage Package, factory NPP Bi-Mode Performance Exhaust, transparent removable roof, navigation, red interior stitching, and suede interior package , and you have a specification that clearly received some thought when it was originally ordered. One of the things we appreciate about this Corvette is that the upgrades haven't taken away from what makes the car special. The Morimoto LED lighting gives the exterior a more contemporary appearance, while the C7 Z06/Z07-style rear spoiler adds a little extra aggression to the already muscular Grand Sport bodywork. The Mild 2 Wild controller provides additional control over the factory NPP exhaust valves, letting the driver enjoy more of that LS3 soundtrack when desired. And the white ball shift knob? A small detail, but one that feels right at home in a manual Corvette. At Texas Hot Rides, we've specialized in enthusiast, performance, collector, and specialty vehicles in the Dallas-Fort Worth area since 2009. We've handled plenty of Corvettes over the years, and we know that the right combination of transmission, equipment, color, and mileage can make a significant difference in how appealing a particular example is. This 2012 Grand Sport checks some particularly important boxes. The six-speed manual is the centerpiece, but the 4LT interior, F55 Magnetic Ride Control, Grand Sport Heritage Package, NPP exhaust, Arctic White and red color combination, and just 35K miles are what make the complete package so appealing. It's a Corvette that offers the performance and involvement enthusiasts love about the C6 Grand Sport, with a factory specification that's becoming increasingly worth seeking out. Arctic White. Six-Speed Manual. 4LT. Magnetic Ride. 35K Miles. This is the kind of Grand Sport we'd be looking for ourselves. Unique Motors is pleased to offer this 2019 Mercedes-Benz AMG C63 S Coupe, finished in the stunning designo Graphite Grey Magno matte exterior over an exclusive Magma Grey and Black Nappa leather interior. Combining handcrafted AMG V8 performance, aggressive styling, and premium luxury appointments, this C63 S represents one of the most desirable configurations of the Mercedes-AMG C-Class Coupe.

Powered by a handcrafted 4.0L Biturbo V8 producing 503 horsepower and 516 lb-ft of torque, paired with an AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 9-speed transmission, the C63 S delivers exhilarating acceleration, exceptional throttle response, and the unmistakable sound of an AMG V8.

description: 2011 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport Coupe For Sale in "Blade Silver Metallic!" Forged LS3 A&A V3 Ti Supercharged Corvette Grand Sport Kooks Headers Corsa Exhaust Only 45K Miles WE FINANCE This is the kind of Corvette that makes perfect sense to us. Start with a C6 Grand Sport Coupe. Wide body. Targa roof. LS3. Great chassis. Then forget about the option sheet and spend the money where it matters. This 2011 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport Coupe is finished in Blade Silver Metallic over Ebony leather with only 45K miles , but the real story lives underneath it. The engine was recently rebuilt and upgraded with forged rods and pistons, upgraded bearings and ARP hardware before being paired with an A&A Corvettes V3 Ti Supercharger System. From there, the build continues with an upgraded A&A 3.8-inch supercharger pulley, upgraded tensioner and pulleys, ATI harmonic balancer, A&A intake, upgraded fuel injectors, Kooks Jet-Hot coated long-tube headers, Kooks free-flow mid-pipe, Corsa Cat-Back Exhaust , and extensive performance tuning. In other words: They didn't spend the money on heated seats. They spent it making an LS3 Grand Sport substantially more interesting. We approve. Built for Boost Putting a supercharger on an LS3 isn't particularly difficult. Building the engine underneath it first is a different conversation. The engine in this Grand Sport was recently rebuilt and upgraded using forged rods and pistons, upgraded bearings and ARP hardware , creating a much more serious foundation for the forced-induction combination sitting above it. That's important because the centerpiece of this build isn't exactly subtle. The A&A Corvettes V3 Ti Supercharger System transforms the naturally aspirated LS3 into a centrifugal-supercharged combination, with an A&A 3.8-inch pulley upgrade spinning the system. Supporting hardware includes the upgraded A&A tensioner and pulleys, an ATI Harmonic Balancer , A&A Intake, upgraded fuel injectors and extensive performance tuning. This isn't a stock LS3 with an air filter and a loud exhaust. The engine was opened. The bottom end was upgraded. Then somebody added boost. That's the kind of modification history that gets our attention. Let It Breathe Once you're moving that much more air through an LS3, the rest of the combination needs to keep up. And this one does. A set of Kooks Jet-Hot Coated Long-Tube Headers feeds into a Kooks Free-Flow Mid-Pipe , with a Corsa Cat-Back Exhaust System handling everything from there back. A&A on the intake side. Kooks underneath. Corsa out back. Good parts in the places that matter. More importantly, the engine and supporting modifications have received extensive performance tuning to bring the combination together. description: 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 When Chevrolet set out to challenge the world's finest sports cars, the result was a Corvette that earned a legendary nickname: “King of the Hill.” This clean 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 represents the debut year of one of the most technologically ambitious Corvettes ever built, combining exotic-engineering pedigree, groundbreaking performance, and distinctive styling in a package that remains highly desirable among Corvette enthusiasts and collectors. Finished in black over a striking red leather interior, this ZR-1 shows just 33,585 miles and offers an especially compelling combination of color, rarity, and historical significance. At the heart of the ZR-1 is the legendary 5.7L LT5 V8, an all-aluminum, 32-valve powerhouse developed with Lotus engineering and manufactured by Mercury Marine. A radical departure from the traditional pushrod small-block, the LT5 featured dual overhead camshafts and four valves per cylinder, producing an impressive 375 horsepower and 370 lb-ft of torque for 1990. Paired with a six-speed manual transmission, the LT5 transformed the C4 Corvette into a genuine world-class performance machine. Its sophisticated engineering and high-revving character helped establish the ZR-1 as a serious challenger to European exotics, earning it the “King of the Hill” title and securing its place in Corvette history. Rare Black-on-Red Combination Rarity adds another dimension to this already significant Corvette. Of the 3,049 ZR-1s produced for the 1990 model year, only 802 were finished in black. More remarkable still, just 71 examples combined the black exterior with the red interior. That makes this car's color combination a particularly distinctive feature for enthusiasts seeking something beyond an ordinary C4 Corvette. With its dramatic exterior and contrasting red cabin, this ZR-1 delivers a memorable presentation backed by genuine production rarity. Exclusive 1990 Design Details The inaugural 1990 ZR-1 has a unique visual identity that separates it from later models. Chevrolet paired the ZR-1's wide, convex rear bodywork with the classic, sharply pointed front nose of the early C4 Corvette. This combination of the original C4 front-end styling and the broader ZR-1 rear gives the 1990 model a look all its own. Another exclusive detail is the high-mounted third brake light positioned atop the rear roof halo panel, rather than between the taillights as on subsequent designs. These model-year-specific details make the first-year ZR-1 especially recognizable to knowledgeable Corvette enthusiasts and collectors. A Landmark in Corvette Performance With just 33,585 miles, a six-speed manual transmission, the celebrated LT5 engine, and a rare black-over-red color combination, this ZR-1 brings together the attributes that make a special-interest Corvette worth remembering. The 1990 model wasn't simply a more powerful C4. It was Chevrolet's bold statement that American engineering could take on the world's best, and it introduced a performance legend that continues to command respect decades later. Three thousand forty-nine built. Just 802 in black. Only 71 with the red interior combination. Finished in sleek Silver with a sophisticated Gray interior, this rear-wheel-drive coupe offers a dynamic driving experience with a 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine producing 208 horsepower at 5500 rpm and 258 lb-ft of torque at 1500 rpm. With an automatic transmission and an average of 22 mpg city and 30 mpg highway, it balances power and efficiency. The vehicle boasts 114,469 miles and comes equipped with features like a backup camera, Bluetooth connectivity, keyless entry, push start, satellite radio readiness, and a sunroof/moonroof. Safety features include 4-wheel ABS, anti-lock door locks with auto-locking, cornering brake control, and anti-lockout door locks, providing peace of mind on every drive. The vehicle’s technology suite features a dual 7-inch and 8-inch infotainment screen, voice-activated hands-free calling, HD radio, a touchscreen display, real-time traffic navigation data, and electronic messaging assistance with read and voice functions. Six speakers deliver clear sound, supported by USB auxiliary audio input, ensuring an engaging in-cabin experience. The combination of safety, entertainment, and connectivity options makes this coupe a compelling choice for drivers seeking a stylish, well-equipped vehicle.

The Q60 includes essential safety features such as 4-wheel ABS, anti-lock door locks with auto-locking, cornering brake control, and anti-lockout door locks, helping protect occupants and prevent theft or unauthorized access. These systems work together to enhance stability, control, and security during various driving conditions.

2017 INFINITI Q60 Entertainment and Technology Features

This model is equipped with dual infotainment screens measuring 7 inches and 8 inches, providing intuitive access to media and navigation. Voice-operated hands-free calling and HD radio keep drivers connected and entertained, while the touchscreen display offers easy control. Real-time traffic data assists with navigation, and electronic messaging with voice readout ensures safety while staying connected. An audio system with six speakers and USB auxiliary input completes the tech package, offering a balanced blend of connectivity and entertainment.

2017 INFINITI Q60 Performance Features

The Q60 features an auto start/stop system that enhances fuel efficiency and reduces emissions, making every drive more economical and eco-friendly. This technology helps optimize engine performance and fuel consumption, contributing to a smoother and more efficient ride.
